name: Shardwake Channels
introDiscord: Fast currents race between razor-thin starstone channels. Shizuki has left several navigation signs here. Their increasing panic suggests the currents won.
introTwitch: Fast currents race between razor-thin starstone channels. Shizuki has left several navigation signs here. Their increasing panic suggests the currents won.

shardwake-channels-approach.prompt: Three channels split ahead beneath signs reading 'SAFE,' 'SAFER,' and 'I HAVE CHANGED MY MIND.'

left.message: A Shardwake Eel rockets from the current like a living spear.

right.message: A Berry is tied to Shizuki's fourth replacement sign: "STOP TAKING MY SIGNS, CURRENT."

forward.message: A meteor-iron reliquary spins inside a calm pocket between the racing channels.

shardwake-channels-depths.prompt: Three faster currents collide beneath increasingly crooked trail markers.

left.message: A tonic is strapped to a rock beneath a note: "Anything not tied down belongs to the trench now."
left.fullHpMessage: The tonic remains securely strapped down. Finally, something here understands commitment.

right.message: A Shardwake Eel rides the current directly toward you.

forward.message: Star Candies have collected behind a natural cometglass barrier.

shardwake-channels-threshold.prompt: The channels spiral toward Splintercurrent Ring.

left.message: A star-chart coffer circles slowly in an eddy.

right.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "Emergency current medicine. Side effects: remaining in approximately same location."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave it untouched and continue remaining approximately where you intended.

forward.message:
"A Shardwake Eel shoots through the final channel. Apparently this is now a race."

BOSS:

boss-antechamber.name: Splintercurrent Ring
boss-antechamber.prompt: The currents twist into a single violent ring.

bossPromptDiscord:
The currents twist into a single violent ring.

Something enormous coils inside it.

Use /yes to enter Splintercurrent Ring or /no to avoid becoming part of the current's next lap.
bossPromptTwitch:
The currents twist into a single violent ring.

Something enormous coils inside it.

Use !yes to enter Splintercurrent Ring or !no to avoid becoming part of the current's next lap.
bossRetreatText: You retreat. One of Shizuki's old signs races past you in the current.

boss.revealText:
A colossal eel uncoils from the ring.

Riftcoil Eel reveals itself!

completionText:
"The current loosens.

A battered sign floats past:

"I KNEW THIS WOULD HAPPEN.""
